{{Top|leg}}
'''Exorant''' were insect-like rodents, considered pests in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. They were shiny, whiskled parasites about 15 centimeters long. Although they attacked by biting, they were not a real threat to humanoid-sized sentients.

[[Karlo]]'s kitchen in [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] station was infested with at least twenty exorants as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
